description: Cross-domain status vocabulary. Each domain is a closed set of states with a color-token reference, an icon glyph name, and a required text label (color is never the only signal — see accessibility docs). The 'calibration' domain values are NOT independently chosen: they mirror aarya_voice_lab.identity.calibration.CalibrationState exactly and are verified against it by tests/contracts-drift.test.mjs.

pipeline_stage.description: Runtime execution status of one pipeline stage instance. This is UI-only vocabulary layered on top of the backend PipelineStage enum (pipeline/stages.py) — it does not rename or replace it.

calibration.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.identity.calibration.CalibrationState exactly. Do not add, rename, or remove values here without updating the backend enum and regenerating frontend/contracts/generated/calibration_state.json.

hardware.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.core.capability.CapabilityState exactly (used by environment/audit.py and the future runtime detection VL-D19 will read). Do not add, rename, or remove values here without updating the backend enum and regenerating frontend/contracts/generated/capability_state.json.

hardware_calibration.description: VL-D1 §19, driven by real state as of VL-D7 — mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.calibration_engine.CalibrationRunState exactly (see frontend/contracts/generated/calibration_run_state.json). This is the AI Calibration Engine's PROCESS state for one calibration run on THIS host. Distinct from the 'calibration' domain above: that one is CalibrationState, about whether a target-speaker verification threshold (or, since VL-D7, a calibration profile) has real evidence behind it. This one is about whether an engine run itself completed. A run can be CALIBRATED here while the 'calibration' domain still reads UNCALIBRATED or PROVISIONAL for the same profile — that combination is expected, not a bug. Before a run has ever happened, the workspace still defaults to UNCALIBRATED / NOT_TESTED with no fabricated numbers.

activity_severity.description: Severity of one activity-timeline event (VL-D1 §13). A different axis from any domain-specific status above — every activity event has exactly one of these regardless of its source (import/pipeline/claude/security/...).

quality_decision.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.quality.QualityDecision exactly (PASS/WARNING/REVIEW/FAIL), plus one UI-only addition (NOT_ANALYZED) for a recording no assessment has run on yet — the same 'superset for the not-yet-run case' pattern the pipeline_stage domain already uses for not_started. Do not add, rename, or remove PASS/WARNING/REVIEW/FAIL without updating the backend enum and regenerating frontend/contracts/generated/quality_decision.json.

overlap_status.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.overlap.OverlapStatus exactly. A heuristic acoustic indicator, never a speaker count or a probability — POSSIBLE_OVERLAP/OVERLAP_DETECTED are candidates for Phase 3 to resolve, never rendered as a confirmed multi-speaker claim.

candidate_review.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.candidate_review.CandidateReviewDecision exactly. Technical review only (review_type='technical') — never a speaker-identity decision. See schemas/candidate_review.schema.json.

processing_status.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.processing.ProcessingStatus exactly. BLOCKED means the item could not be processed at all (source verification failed); WARNING means it completed with a caveat (e.g. an optional tool was unavailable) — neither is ever silently upgraded to SUCCESS.

processing_decision.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.processing.ProcessingDecision exactly. A config-driven DECISION, never computed by the UI itself.

noise_conditioning_mode.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.processing_profile.NoiseConditioningMode exactly. OFF/MEASURE_ONLY are implemented; LIGHT/STANDARD are a real, closed vocabulary with no tool wired up yet in VL-D4 and render as NOT AVAILABLE rather than being silently treated as MEASURE_ONLY.

generation_status.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.generation.GenerationStatus exactly. BLOCKED means the request could not be generated at all (validation failed or the backend is unavailable); WARNING means it completed with a caveat — neither is ever silently upgraded to READY.

voice_profile_state.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.voice_profile.VoiceProfileState exactly. SYNTHETIC_PROFILE or UNCALIBRATED only in VL-D5 -- no real speaker profile is ever auto-populated or promoted past these.

generation_backend_state.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.generation.GenerationBackendState exactly. Never render an unavailable/unconfigured backend as successful — the UI must show exactly this state, never infer readiness.

evaluation_completion_state.description: Mirrors aarya_voice_lab.pipeline.evaluation.EvaluationCompletionState exactly (VL-D6). Do not add, rename, or remove values here without updating the backend enum and regenerating frontend/contracts/generated/evaluation_completion_state.json.
